import re

for n in ['requests','supervision','work-queue']:
    d=open(D+n+'.md').read()
    parts=re.split(r'^## (.+)\n',d,flags=re.M)
    secs={parts[i]:parts[i+1] for i in range(1,len(parts),2)}
    s=open(S+n+'.md').read()
    if 'frontmatter' in secs:
        fm=secs['frontmatter'].strip('\n')
        s=re.sub(r'\A---\n.*?\n---',lambda m:fm,s,count=1,flags=re.S)
    for name,body in secs.items():
        if name=='frontmatter': continue
        pat=re.compile(r'^## '+re.escape(name)+r'\n.*?(?=^## |\Z)',re.M|re.S)
        assert pat.search(s),(n,name)
        s=pat.sub(lambda m:'## '+name+'\n'+body.rstrip('\n')+'\n\n',s,count=1)
    s=s.rstrip('\n')+'\n'
    open(S+n+'.md','w').write(s)
E
